mods.name: GitHub Notifications
mods.author: Atelier Examples
mods.summary: Your unread GitHub notifications as a widget and a Dock badge. Needs a personal access token with the notifications scope.
mods.description:
# GitHub Notifications

Unread notifications from GitHub, on your desktop.

1. Run **Set GitHub Token** from the Command palette.
2. Paste a classic personal access token with the `notifications` scope. Make one at [github.com/settings/tokens](https://github.com/settings/tokens).
3. Add a **Plugin** widget to the board and choose *GitHub*.

The token is kept in the plugin's own storage and sent only to `api.github.com`, the one host it may reach. Clicking the Dock tile opens your notifications in the browser.

> Pull requests waiting for your review are drawn in orange.

screenshots.caption: Unread notifications on the board, with a badge on the Dock tile.

mods.name: Midnight Glass
mods.author: Atelier Examples
mods.summary: Ink-blue Liquid Glass over a slow nebula, with a custom four-stop palette.
mods.description:
# Midnight Glass

Ink-blue glass over a slow nebula.

- **Dock**: glass, dot indicators, soft reflection.
- **Widgets**: glass with an indigo tint.
- **Wallpaper**: the *Nebula* live wallpaper on a custom palette, slowed for the night.
- **Menu bar**: notchless.
- **Icons**: clear, dark.

Applying it changes nothing you can't take back: **Revert** in Looks restores your setup.

screenshots.caption: Glass Dock and widgets over the Nebula live wallpaper.

mods.name: Paper Studio
mods.author: Atelier Examples
mods.summary: Warm paper and serif type over a still mesh that follows the hour. No motion at all.
mods.description:
# Paper Studio

Warm paper and serif type, and nothing that moves.

- **Wallpaper**: a still mesh in dusk colours, no animation at all.
- **Dock**: frosted, with a bar indicator and no icon shadows.
- **Widgets**: frosted amber, serif type, soft corners.
- **Clock**: a serif face on the desktop.

Made for long days of reading and writing, and kind to the battery.

screenshots.caption: Serif clock and paper widgets over a still mesh.

mods.name: Pomodoro
mods.author: Atelier Examples
mods.summary: A focus timer as a Dock tile, a widget, a command and a hot-corner action.
mods.description:
# Pomodoro

Twenty-five minutes of focus, five of rest. Click the Dock tile to start or pause.

- **Dock tile** with the time left, a progress ring and a badge for finished sessions.
- **Widget** for the board, with the same ring.
- **Command**: *Start or Pause Pomodoro* in the Command palette.
- **Hot corner**: put *Pomodoro* on any corner in Hot Corners.

A notification tells you when a session ends. That is the only permission it asks for.

It is also the reference plugin: every kind of registration in one short script. Read `main.js` to see how each one works.

screenshots.caption: The Dock tile counts down; the widget shows the ring.

mods.name: Random Wallpaper Palette
mods.author: Atelier Examples
mods.summary: A command and a hot-corner action that give the live wallpaper, Dock and widgets a fresh, harmonious palette.
mods.description:
# Random Wallpaper Palette

One shortcut, a new mood. Each shuffle picks a hue, then three more a little further round the colour wheel, from deep shadow to bright crest, and applies them to:

- the live wallpaper's palette,
- the Dock and widget accents,
- Atelier's own accent.

Run **Random Wallpaper Palette** from the Command palette, or put **Random Palette** on a hot corner.

Not this time? **Revert** in Looks puts back everything from before the first change.

screenshots.caption: Each shuffle picks four stops a little further round the colour wheel.

mods.name: Sunset Neon
mods.author: Atelier Examples
mods.summary: A neon grid under a striped sun. Hot pink edges, gradient widgets, a bold clock.
mods.description:
# Sunset Neon

A neon grid under a striped sun.

- **Wallpaper**: the *Retro Horizon* live wallpaper.
- **Dock**: neon, with a glow indicator and a wave curve.
- **Widgets**: a pink-to-orange gradient, monospaced type.
- **Clock**: big and bold. Icons tinted pink.
- **Sounds**: a little funk when it is applied.

Best on a dark setup, at night.

screenshots.caption: The neon grid with gradient widgets and a bold clock.
